items.html: And with this the matter of this statement, which disagrees with the Sifra deTzniuta, will be reconciled. For there it says the opposite: the judgments of the female are calm in the head and strong in the end, and the reverse in the male. But the matter is that the Sifra deTzniuta speaks of the aspect of the judgments themselves, which are the aspect of the NNH of ZA, in which is the secret of the judgments, as explained above. And behold, they enter and become the aspect of mochin in the head of the Nukva; but of the NNH of the Nukva there is no other Partzuf in Atzilut beneath her in which they could be made in the aspect of mochin. It follows therefore that her judgments, which are her NNH, are strong at the end.
